name: B04_Fineroot morphology_chemistry_raw_data
description: Fine root morphological and functional variables in three soil depths (0-10, 10-30, 30-50 cm) across tropical land-use systems namely natural forest, jungle rubber, rubber monocultures, and oil palm plantations from 32 plots. The file contains the raw data of all the 32 plots.

citation.name: "Consequences of tropical rainforest conversion to tree plantations on fine root dynamics and functional traits" by Kotowska, Martyna; Samhita, Sasya; Hertel, Dietrich; Triadiati, Triadiati; Beyer, Friderike; Allen, Kara; Link, Roman; Leuschner, Christoph.

distribution.name: B04_fineroot_morphology_chemistry_raw_data.tab
distribution.description: The file contains the raw data of all the 32 plots. Including two different methods -"fine root inventory" & "sequential coring"
